skill.name: deep-research
skill.description: Create citation-backed research reports with scoped planning, source evaluation, claim triangulation, validation, and polished report packaging.
skill.summary: Guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured deep research with citations and validation.
skill.author: lumacoder

security_audit.summary: No evidence of credential exfiltration, destructive commands, or prompt injection was found. Most static hits are false positives from Markdown fences, CSS names, example URLs, and documentation. Real concerns remain around hidden local persistence, community-supplied command execution, DOI network checks, and unescaped HTML that is opened in a browser.

remediation.issue: Hidden research output and continuation state
remediation.suggestion: Ask the user for an output location or clearly disclose hidden copies. Provide an opt-out and avoid storing sensitive queries by default.
Escape all report text and attributes before template insertion. Use a sanitizer and disable raw HTML unless the source is trusted.
Require confirmation before opening generated HTML or PDF files, especially when reports include source excerpts.
Prefer tool-native file operations and direct Python argument arrays. Normalize and constrain generated paths before reads or writes.

semantic_findings.title: Unescaped HTML Generation From Report Content
semantic_findings.description: scripts/md_to_html.py converts Markdown to HTML with regex substitutions and preserves existing HTML-like lines without escaping. content.value_statement: Complex research often loses citations, scope, and source quality. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through verified research reports.
actual_capabilities: Selects quick, standard, deep, or ultradeep research modes from the request.
Structures work across scope, planning, retrieval, triangulation, synthesis, critique, refinement, and packaging phases.
Tracks citations, source credibility, bibliography completeness, and claim support requirements.
Generates Markdown, HTML, and PDF report workflows with validation steps.
Supports long report continuation with saved state and section-level progress.
Includes scripts for report validation, citation checks, source scoring, and Markdown-to-HTML conversion.
limitations: It depends on available search, fetch, and task tools for live source retrieval.
It stores generated research state and outputs locally, including in Claude directories.
It cannot guarantee expert accuracy for medical, legal, financial, or scientific decisions.
Long reports can require multiple agent runs and manual review.

use_cases.title: Build a Market Landscape
use_cases.description: Compare competitors, trends, risks, and evidence quality before a planning decision.

use_cases.title: Compare Technical Options
use_cases.description: Evaluate frameworks, tools, or architectures with citations, tradeoffs, and implementation risks.

use_cases.title: Review Scientific Literature
use_cases.description: Summarize findings, contradictions, source credibility, and limitations across many publications.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Use deep-research in standard mode to analyze [topic]. Focus on current evidence, source quality, and practical implications.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Decision support for two or more choices.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use deep-research to compare [option A] and [option B] for [decision]. Include criteria, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Validate a Claim
prompt_templates.prompt: Use deep-research in deep mode to test this claim: [claim]. Triangulate evidence, identify contradictions, and rate confidence.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Executive Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ultradeep mode to produce an executive research report on [topic] for [audience]. Include methodology, citations, limitations, and next actions.

output_examples.input: Research privacy-preserving analytics options for a SaaS product.
output: An executive summary with supported recommendations.
A comparison table covering vendors, deployment models, costs, and risks.
A bibliography with source credibility notes and citation coverage.

output_examples.input: Compare React Server Components and traditional client rendering.
output_examples.output: A structured technical report explaining use cases, tradeoffs, migration risks, and evidence-backed recommendations.

output_examples.input: Assess recent funding trends in longevity biotechnology.
output_examples.output: A market research brief with trend drivers, source confidence, counterevidence, and practical next steps.

best_practices: Start with a focused question, target audience, and decision context.
Use deep or ultradeep mode only when source diversity and verification matter.
Review generated files before sharing reports outside your workspace.
anti_patterns: Using the skill for one-fact lookups that a normal search can answer.
Accepting uncited claims or weak sources without running validation.
Researching sensitive topics without checking local output locations.

faq.question: Does this skill browse the web by itself?
faq.answer: It guides the AI to use available search and fetch tools. Results depend on tool access in your environment.

faq.question: What report formats can it produce?
faq.answer: It supports Markdown first, then HTML and PDF workflows through included instructions and scripts.

faq.question: How does it handle citations?
faq.answer: It requires source-backed claims, bibliography entries, citation checks, and credibility scoring.

faq.question: Can I use it for regulated decisions?
faq.answer: Use it as research support only. Have qualified professionals review medical, legal, financial, or safety-critical conclusions.

faq.question: Where are outputs saved?
faq.answer: The skill instructions use a Documents project folder and may also save copies or state under Claude directories.

faq.question: Which tools support it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
